_meta.name: Documentation-assist map (note ↔ code linkage)
_meta.purpose: For each code: what the note must contain to support it. This is pillar 3 of the provider app — the piece Codify/Encoda don't do well.
_meta.source: Office/outpatient E/M selectors paraphrased from published 2021+ AMA E/M guidance (total time on the encounter date, or MDM 2-of-3). Time ranges and MDM levels are objective, published guidance — NOT AMA-licensed long descriptions.
_meta.action_required: VALIDATE every entry against BHW's own Coders' Specialty Guide / Documentation Guide before relying on it clinically. This seed covers only the office E/M family + AWV. Extend it (per the brief) to the highest-volume codes next: behavioral (90837/90834/99484), CCM (99490/99484/G0557), cognitive (99483), Flow (93923/93923-family).
_meta.em_thresholds: minMinutes = the lower bound of that code's published total-time range; mdm = the minimum MDM level that supports the code (2 of 3 elements).

supports: Medicare Annual Wellness Visit — INITIAL
Only billable once per lifetime, and not within 12 months of the 'Welcome to Medicare' (G0402)
Requires the AWV elements: HRA, medication review, screening schedule, cognitive assessment, etc.
G0438.source: CMS AWV requirements — confirm interval vs claims/MAC (see providers.js extractAwv)

supports: Medicare Annual Wellness Visit — SUBSEQUENT
Billable once per 12 months after an initial AWV (G0438)
Requires updated HRA + care plan

supports: Psychotherapy, ~30 min (16–37 min) with patient
Document therapy time separate from any E/M, and the type & content of therapy
Standalone — do NOT report with an E/M (use add-on 90833 instead)
Psychotherapy, ~45 min (38–52 min) with patient
Document therapy time (separate from E/M) and the type & content of therapy
Standalone — do NOT report with an E/M (use add-on 90836 instead)
Psychotherapy, ~60 min (53+ min) with patient
Document therapy time (separate from E/M) and the type & content of therapy
Standalone — do NOT report with an E/M (use add-on 90838 instead)
Psychotherapy, ~30 min — ADD-ON to an E/M service
Requires a reportable E/M on the same day; the E/M must be selected by MDM (time cannot be used when a psych add-on is billed)
Separately identify the medical and psychotherapeutic components in the note
Psychotherapy, ~45 min — ADD-ON to an E/M service
Requires a same-day E/M selected by MDM (not time)
Separately identify the E/M and psychotherapy components in the note
Psychotherapy, ~60 min — ADD-ON to an E/M service
Requires a same-day E/M selected by MDM (not time)
Separately identify the E/M and psychotherapy components in the note
General behavioral health integration (BHI) care management, ~20 min/month of clinical staff time directed by the provider
Document the monthly time, the systematic assessment/monitoring, care-plan revision, and continuity with a designated care team member
